tablerow.td: Dead. If all else fails the character can make a check for Divine Intervention.
Dying. They will be dead at the end of the next round unless someone intervenes.
Unconscious. The character gains the Unconscious condition but is otherwise stable on 1 health.
Wounded. Suffer some permanent disability, They have lost an eye or a hand, their face has been badly burned Gain the Checked condition and 1d3 hit points. Lose the Near-Death condition.
Bleeding Out Fast. Roll again next round with three shifts down.
Bleeding Out. Roll again next round with two shifts down.
It doesn't look good. Roll again next round with one shift down.
Improving. Roll again next round with a one shift up.
Getting Better. Roll again next round with two shifts up.
Out Cold. The character gains the Unconscious condition and 1 health. Lose the Near-Death condition.
Where am I?. Character gains the Dazed condition, the Checked condition and 1 health.Lose the Near-Death condition.
A Flesh Wound. Heals to 1 health and 1 Stamina, gains the Dazed condition. Lose the Near-Death condition.
I'm Fine. Heals 3 Health and 3 Stamina. Lose the Near-Death condition.
Never Been Better. Heals 5 health and 5 Stamina. Lose the Near-Death condition.
